name: DEEP
summary: 3D gaze pointing in VR that uses eyelid movement (squinting or opening the eyes) to move the pointer in depth.
howItWorks: Gaze direction sets where the pointer is, and how wide the user opens or narrows the eyelids shifts it nearer or further, allowing selection at different depths.
